themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents capable of independent research, analysis, and task execution within research contexts.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Covers a broad spectrum of AI-powered tools designed to assist in various stages of research, from data collection to analysis.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Articles discussing AI tools that help developers write, review, debug, and optimize code.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: AI applications focused on condensing large amounts of text, such as meeting notes, research papers, or articles, into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Examines how AI is integrated into the design process and supports user research activities.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Explores how AI is changing job roles, skill requirements, hiring, and the overall employment landscape.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Focuses on the use, capabilities, and implications of AI chatbots specifically within research and user interaction.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: Articles that review, compare, or assess the usability and effectiveness of various AI tools.

themes.name: AI research platform
themes.description: Details platforms and systems built to facilitate and manage AI-driven research processes.

themes.name: AI sentiment & feedback
themes.description: Covers the use of AI to analyze customer sentiment, reviews, and feedback to derive actionable insights.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
